sources.quote: The FDA either physically inspected or conducted remote regulatory assessments of 48 GLP-1 API sites and found that nearly one-fifth were not compliant under section 501 of the FD&C Act.
sources.page_context: detained without physical examination (DWPE) unless they are on a list (Green List) of approved foreign GLP-1 manufacturers. The “Green List” was developed after evidence was provided to the FDA from manufacturers demonstrating that they meet current good manufacturing practice (CGMP) requirements. The FDA either physically inspected or conducted remote regulatory assessments of 48 GLP-1 API sites and found that nearly one-fifth were not compliant under section 501 of the FD&C Act. These sites either did not provide the records required to prove that they met CGMP requirements or did not meet those CGMP requirements.
